name: metadata
sql: CREATE TABLE metadata(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,value TEXT)

name: stops
sql: CREATE TABLE stops(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,sid TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL)

name: patterns
sql: CREATE TABLE patterns(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,service INTEGER,rail INTEGER,wait REAL,trips TEXT)

name: rides
sql: CREATE TABLE rides(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,pattern INTEGER,origin INTEGER,destination INTEGER,boarding INTEGER,alighting INTEGER,seconds REAL)

name: paths
sql: CREATE TABLE paths(origin INTEGER,destination INTEGER,data BLOB NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(origin,destination)) WITHOUT ROWID

name: progress
sql: CREATE TABLE progress(stage INTEGER,origin INTEGER,paths INTEGER,pairs INTEGER,seconds REAL,PRIMARY KEY(stage,origin)) WITHOUT ROWID

name: walks
sql:
CREATE TABLE "walks"(
  id,
  origin INT,
  destination INT,
  internal INT,
  seconds REAL,
  meters REAL
)

name: expanded_paths
sql:
CREATE TABLE expanded_paths(origin INTEGER,destination INTEGER,data BLOB NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY(origin,destination)) WITHOUT ROWID

name: expanded_progress
sql: CREATE TABLE expanded_progress(origin INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,new_pairs INTEGER,added_routes INTEGER,changed_pairs INTEGER,seconds REAL)

name: topup_paths
sql:
CREATE TABLE topup_paths(origin INTEGER,destination INTEGER,data BLOB NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY(origin,destination)) WITHOUT ROWID

name: topup_progress
sql: CREATE TABLE topup_progress(origin INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,new_pairs INTEGER,added_routes INTEGER,changed_pairs INTEGER,seconds REAL)

name: short_walk_paths
sql:
CREATE TABLE short_walk_paths(
                    origin INTEGER, destination INTEGER,
                    meters REAL NOT NULL CHECK(meters>=0 AND meters<=300),
                    seconds REAL NOT NULL CHECK(seconds>=0), source TEXT NOT NULL,
                    previous_routes INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(previous_routes>=0 AND previous_routes<5),
                    origin_lat REAL, origin_lon REAL, destination_lat REAL, destination_lon REAL,
                    PRIMARY KEY(origin,destination)) WITHOUT ROWID
